C-RELEASE-0-4-1.Summary: Publish Kafedra Planner 0.4.1 from the clean main branch with synchronized version authorities, factual release notes and verified offline artifacts.
C-RELEASE-0-4-1.Problem: Main contains completed post-0.4.0 reliability and desktop-plan improvements, but users cannot install them as a named, checksummed release until version metadata, release documentation, CI, tag and GitHub assets are advanced together.

Goals.Goal: Advance VERSION, package metadata and current-version documentation from 0.4.0 to 0.4.1 without dependency or schema changes.
Generate release notes from the actual first-parent history between v0.4.0 and the release branch.
Prove the full project, database, release, offline and systemd gates on one exact release head and again on merged main.
Publish a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release v0.4.1 with the install entrypoint, full offline bundle and external SHA-256 evidence.

Constraints.Constraint: The exact release base is the immutable parent of the first C-RELEASE-0-4-1 planning commit and equals refs/heads/main observed when branch release/0.4.1 was created.
No new feature, API behavior, SQLite schema, migration, dependency, Docker, CDN, cloud or mandatory LLM change is included.
No mobile-specific mode, navigation or release claim is introduced.
Applied migrations and immutable document/source data remain untouched.
Astra Linux stability is not claimed without the separate target acceptance process; this release remains a verified autonomous candidate for supported Debian/Astra profiles.
A temporary release-preparation workflow may write only approved release files and must delete itself before the implementation PR.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Merge drafts or incomplete feature branches.
Close open roadmap issues that are not implemented.
Change schema version 31 or publish a destructive installer.
Change the current user interface beyond already merged features.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No active GRACE change or merge-ready unmerged production PR exists at the release base.
VERSION, package.json and package-lock.json agree on 0.4.1; dependency identities and lock integrity are unchanged.
README, ROADMAP and UX_FLOWS describe 0.4.1 as the current release without rewriting historical feature evidence.
docs/releases/0.4.1.md lists only commits and user-visible changes actually present after v0.4.0 and explicitly states that schema remains 31.
GRACE final and all mandatory project checks succeed on one unchanged PR head; squash merge is followed by successful post-merge CI.
A separate archive-only PR moves the full C-RELEASE-0-4-1 bundle to applied before public release creation.
GitHub API confirms tag and published release v0.4.1 at the exact archived main commit, with required offline/install assets and checksum evidence.
The release issue closes only after release workflow completion and asset verification.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact release head, merged main, terminal archive, tag, release object and checksummed artifacts all identify the same 0.4.1 source.
